# Arc

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Generate an arc path between two points at a given altitude.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/arc",
  "type": "ArcOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/arc').par.source` (an input) and `op('/arc').out.path` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.source`, `out.path`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `source` | `Point3DField` | `{"lng":0,"lat":0,"alt":0}` |
| `target` | `Point3DField` | `{"lng":0,"lat":0,"alt":0}` |
| `altitudeMultiplier` | `NumberField` | `2` |
| `apexAlt` | `NumberField` | `10000` |
| `smoothHeight` | `BooleanField` | `true` |
| `smoothPosition` | `BooleanField` | `true` |
| `segmentCount` | `NumberField` | `250` |
| `tilt` | `NumberField` | `0` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `path` | `ArrayField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
